headline: PHI @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 2.83 at MIL 4.53, with a projected total of 7.36. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: PHI moved +0.20 runs while MIL moved +0.86, changing the projected margin by -0.66 runs. The projected total climbed +1.06, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jacob Misiorowski has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jackson Chourio, Christian Yelich, Brice Turang, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags J.T. Realmuto, Garrett Stubbs because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
